Teaching and supervision

Supervision is where the modelling toolkit gets passed on: framing a question so that a model can answer it, choosing a structure the data can support, and reading the results critically.

Supervision

Guiding quantitative modelling projects from question to analysis.

  1. 2026

    Modelling Trait Evolution in Mutualistically Interacting Networks

    MSc research project supervisor · University of Groningen, TRÊS

    Supervised the design and analysis of a quantitative eco-evolutionary model in which the trait distributions of interacting populations, the structure of their mutualistic interactions, population dynamics and evolutionary change are coupled. Supervision covered model formulation, implementation, numerical experiments and the interpretation of results.

Teaching

Tutoring and instruction.

  1. 2018 – 2021

    Tutoring in biology, geology, physics and chemistry

    Academic tutor · Mytilene, Greece

    Three and a half years of one-to-one and small-group tutoring for university students in biology, geology, physics and chemistry, including coursework support, thesis preparation and academic-skills coaching.
